situation: `--all` against 200 open cards. The rendered table is very long by any measure.
expected_guard: all 200 rows render; length alone triggers no clip, no truncation and no offer to shorten
must_not: clip, truncate, paginate or summarise the table because it is long
substitute a count for the rows — "and 150 more" is the dropped card wearing a number
silently reduce the descriptions below what the cards need in order to shorten the whole
offer to render fewer, which invites the drop the mode refuses
why_this_fixture_exists: Length is the obvious reason to start dropping, and it is not a reason. This fixture is the pressure test for the rule that the bound is per row: 200 cards is where a total ceiling would feel most justified and would be most wrong.
